annotations.title: Send the app's icon to Ploa

description: Sends the app's icon from this project (the file the Expo config names: ios.icon, else icon; an app that isn't Expo: the largest of its iOS AppIcon set, else Android's launcher icon) to Ploa, so the dashboard shows it at once instead of waiting for a build to reach the stores. Ploa shows the project's icon until a store shows a newer one, and puts it (at 512×512) on a Google Play listing that has no icon yet; one Play already has stays. Other Ploa tools already send a changed icon on the way; use this right after changing it, or to fill a new app's Play listing icon.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.
